RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Question for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 16th, 2002/Asadha 25, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance and Company
Affairs; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—48
14
Posting of CISF personnel at airports
52. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to entrust the security of all airports in the
country to the Central Industrial Security
Force;
(b) if so, the number of airports where
the CISF personnel have already been
posted; and
(c) by when all the airports will have
CISF personnel posted there?
Extra fair for overweight passengers
53. SHRI C.P. THIRUNAVUKKA-
RASU: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the  Air India and Indian Air
Lines propose to implement policy of
charging extra fair to overweight passengers
like other foreign airlines;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Privatization of airports at
metro cities
54. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to privatize airports at four metro cities of
the country;
(b) if so, the names of parties which
have shown interest to take over the
management of these airports; and
(c) what are the main conditions in this
regard?
Facilities at Hyderabad airport
55. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the present status of major
passenger facilities upgradation works
started by Airports Authority of India at
Hyderabad airport recently; and
(b) the total expenditure incurred thereon
and the details of facilities upgraded
so far?

Varying levies on liquor
56. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether he is aware that in addition
to excise duties the Indian Made Foreign
Liquor is subjected to several widely varying
levies, duties and packaging and labelling
regulations imposed by the various State
Governments;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Imported Foreign Liquor
is also subjected to the same levies, duties
and regulations as imposed on Indian Made
Foreign Liquor;
(d) whether any instructions have been
issued by Government to this effect and the
details thereof; and
(e) if so, what steps have been taken to
ensure compliance with these instructions?
Negative growth in exports
57. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India's exports have slid back
to the negative growth path after two years
of positive growth;
(b) if so, whether they have failed to
recover from the impact of the global
economic slowdown and September 11
attack and India's exports failed to clock
any growth during 2001-2002;
(c) if so, to what extent the exports
growth slid down; and
(d) what steps are being taken to improve
the export growth?
Placing of India on p riority watchlist
by USA
58. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the United States has once
again placed India on the priority watchlist
of its Special 301 provision to deal with
intellectual property violations;
(b) if so, whether the failure to provide
patent protection for pharmaceuticals and
farm chemicals has been cited as the main
cause for the action;
(c) whether after the annual review, the
US Trade Representative has opted to put
India, the 15-nation European Union and
12 other countries on the watch list for
another year;
(d) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto; and
(e) the steps being taken in this regard?
Visit of Canadian Trade Team to India
59. SHRI SURESH BHARDWAJ:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE  AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Canadian Trade
Team had visited India very recently (April
2002);
(b) if so, what was the outcome of the
Trade Team visit;
(c) the number of Agreements/MoUs/
treaties etc. signed alongwith the details
thereof; and
(d) in what manner Indian trades would
get boost from these agreements?

Export of sandstone and granite
60. SHRI KAILASH JOSHI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the countries which
import sandstone and granite from
India;
(b) the value of exports made during the
last two years; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take to boost the exports of sandstone and
granite?
Free Trade Agreement with Sri Lanka
61. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and Sri
Lanka have agreed to expand the Free Trade
Agreement and propose to include the
service sector too in it;
